inputs.text: John Lahart is right that people without children shouldn’t be treated as less deserving under inheritance tax rules. But fairness can’t stop at recognizing different family structures: inheritance itself lets wealth and advantage pass down, reinforcing inequality. Reform should protect people from discrimination without giving those with wealth more ways to preserve privilege, and ensure public resources aren’t sacrificed to private inheritance.
